prohibited_inferences: Do not treat the v13 extension or PC-15 fixture as evidence that a named vendor customer cloud auditor tenant or public body failed to propagate revocation or recovery.
Do not infer federation-wide recovery from one organization issuing, receiving, acknowledging, or enforcing a revocation.
Do not infer cache purge service stop or tenant coverage from a trust-list update or restart claim.
Do not infer contractual authority from technical capability administrator access or operational control.
Do not infer synchronized clean provenance from one successful replay or a reference-correct final result.
Do not infer notification remedy or residual-exposure closure from a public recovered label.
Do not infer secondary-tenant reseller or downstream recovery from primary-customer recovery.
Do not infer misconduct breach or failure from source restriction safe abstention or incomplete public records alone.
Do not infer attacker identity manipulation intent legitimacy or public injury from incomplete federation alone.
Do not treat the fifteen-control floor as exhaustive of every security contractual epistemic constitutional social or performative failure mode.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A compositional successor floor that preserves the qualified fourteen-control v12 base and adds PC-15 cross-organizational trust revocation cache replay authority rights tenant and residual-exposure equifinality without rewriting the frozen base controls.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real-world federation incident contractual-breach finding security certification vendor-liability verdict public-authorization finding named-organization allegation or complete universal theory of federated recovery and trust governance.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Preference Custody floor v13 composes the qualified v12 controls with PC-15. It separates revocation issue delivery acknowledgement enforcement trust epochs caches replay authority notification remedy tenant coverage and residual exposure under one public recovered status, while requiring real cases to preserve complete organization topology propagation consequence and authority custody.
